query:
WITH inserted AS (
            INSERT INTO tracked_projects (user_id, project_id)
            VALUES ($1, $2)
            ON CONFLICT (user_id, project_id) DO UPDATE SET created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at
            RETURNING project_id, created_at
        )
        SELECT p.id, p.github_owner, p.github_name, p.gitee_owner, p.gitee_name, p.language,
               p.topics, p.description, p.stars, p.forks, p.open_issues,
               p.has_chinese_readme, p.has_gitee_mirror,
               COALESCE(ds.asia_readiness_score, NULL) AS score, i.created_at AS tracked_at
        FROM inserted i
        JOIN projects p ON p.id = i.project_id
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT asia_readiness_score
            FROM daily_snapshots
            WHERE project_id = p.id
            ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) ds ON true
